method: Clean geometry reconstruction. Manually drawn title and geometric route glyphs, with existing font outlines for remaining small/lower glyphs. Source segmentation is used for placement and QA measurements only; no traced bitmap boundaries or raster images are in the artwork.
placement: Identity source-coordinate grid. Individual lettering placement is part of artwork reconstruction; no extra transformation is used when comparing the completed source and vector.
